recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-5494; any future cleanup of the current section.code prose should be handled as a separate editorial tracker rather than reviving the superseded invariant.
issue_request: FHIR-5494 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Structured Documents ballot comment asking to clarify the invariant that a Composition.section could only have a code if it had no content, with a suggested note that section.code was only used when subsections were present.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5494 was found. The relevant application history is FHIR-5155 commit cdebd6f91d71248ac4eb50636dad18b4e4bf0dbc, which removed the old Composition.section code/content invariant and updated section.code comments.
additional_context: The FHIR-5494 Jira comments state that it was superseded by FHIR-5155 and no longer applicable. FHIR-5155 is Published/Persuasive for the same Composition artifact and resolved to remove the constraint because FHIR does not have context conduction and section.code does not change the meaning of nested or referenced resources. Current source keeps Composition in build scope and has no old code/content invariant.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding the FHIR-5494 requested note would be obsolete and potentially misleading after FHIR-5155, because section.code is no longer limited to sections that only contain subsections.
